title: DQI: Measuring Data Quality in NLP

bias_targets.methodology: Developing and computing a generic Data Quality Index (DQI) comprising mathematical formulas that evaluate text properties such as vocabulary variance, n-gram frequency per label, inter/intra-sample semantic textual similarity (STS), length mismatch, and lexical overlap to detect unintended correlations between input and output.

Analyzing the occurrence of sets of stereotype n-grams in hypotheses that act as contextual biases, predisposing the model to predict a particular label based on systemic dataset patterns rather than actual logic.
Identifying the absence of gender information as a spurious statistical indicator predisposing models toward predicting the 'entailment' label in Natural Language Inference (NLI) datasets.
